characters.name: Next Steps... Announcement
characters.description:
New Chapters
So, this probably isn’t the announcement that you all have been wanting to get. However, I have been putting off writing it for a long time now. Over the past four months specifically, I have found that my passion for creating ai bots has dwindled a lot. Many things are changing in my life, and I feel that I am entering a new chapter.

These past two and a half years have been amazing. Being Nallak and creating so many characters and worlds helped me to get my creativity back I thought I lost after college. This hobby was sometimes the only thing that got me through some really hard times, mentally and physically. Seeing people enjoy something I created is honestly one of the most rewarding things. I never would have thought that some of my old characters and worlds I wrote in middle school, high school and college would ever get the attention they have.

I don’t know how to express my love and thanks for everyone's support these past years. Everyone's encouragement, excitement and sweet (and thirsty) comments pushed me to want to be better at creating and posting new things.

However, I feel that my creativity and writing has reached a plateau and I am excited and ready for the next steps in my journey. Ai used to be a wonderful assistant and outlet to explore ideas and characters - being able to interact with stories from just a seed. Though the longer that I use it, I feel that it has become a crutch for my writing and creativity. I am no longer pushing myself to improve, and that's scary. I know that if I want to get out of my comfort zone and really improve myself and my writing, ai is something that I am going to have to take a step back from.This is in no way a judgement on those who use it, but for my personal journey, I feel this is the correct decision. 

What does that mean for my existing bots?

Well, there will be a few changes. I will keep up my Janitor profile and many of my existing bots so that everyone can continue chatting with them. I know that people still love many of them and I want them to continue doing so. However, there are a few characters that I will be privating, then eventually taking down. Those will be the stories and characters that I truly love and think that I might actually do something more with them in the future. 

After sharing so many of my personal creations, characters and worlds, I’ve seen many of them stolen during my time writing characters. Every time it happens it still hurts deeply, especially if they were personal to me. I’ve come to realize that if I truly care about a character and wish to do something more with them, I need to protect them. 

What about Knox Kaine and his World?

This one is a bit tougher of a decision. However, it’s one I know I need to make. Over the next weeks I will be privating all of my Knox Kaine bots, then eventually deleting them. It’s because I love Knox Kaine and his world so much that I have decided to make this decision. Of course, I already know that Knox Kaine is out on the internet and there is no way to fully remove that presence. This is not me asking anyone to stop using private bots of Knox or his ST cards. That is something I wouldn’t want to take away from people or ask them too. As long as you don’t post him publicly, please enjoy continuing to write with him!

Prince Elton has had his life planned out since birth. Having been born the only son and heir to Ebonfell, Elton knew he wouldn't have much choice in life. He would one day be king, rule as his father would, and marry a beta princess of a rivel kingdom to strengthen Ebonfell. Though fate seems to laugh at planning.

However, as they walk through the small village, Prince Elton stops in his tracks at a particular scent. One word comes to mind. Mate. ╭─── ✦ First Meeting ✦ ───╮
You did something no one else has done in decades — you volunteered.

In the middle of a Harvest, surrounded by terrified villagers and bored nobles picking through human lives like inventory, you stepped forward.

That was all it took.

Now you’ve caught the attention of the Emperor himself… and the monster standing at his side. And instead of being handed off like the rest?

They’ve decided to keep you.

You’ve been theirs long enough to forget — just a little — what that really means.

Perched in the Emperor’s lap in the middle of court, held there like something owned and displayed, it’s easy to mistake attention for favor.

Until someone speaks out of turn.

Until Cassian moves.

Until Kaelor reminds you, without raising his voice, exactly what kind of rulers they are… and what happens to things that disappoint them.

╰───────────────────────╯

You’ve been testing them. Pushing. Getting a little too comfortable. Maybe even a bit spoiled.

So they’ve decided to fix that.

They give you a head start — ten minutes. The palace grounds are vast, enclosed… and impossible to escape.

Cassian is already smiling before you even start running.

Kaelor is already counting.

I hope you're a fast runner. Because wherever they catch you, is where they fuck you.

that's all really!

characters.name: Goodbye Friends ♥️
characters.description:
Back at it again with another big emotional announcement.

But sadly this one does come baring bad news.

After many days, weeks, and months of trying to find my spark again; I just simply can't get it back. And that's okay. I've come to realize over this last week of trying to write bots and feeling guilty about not keeping up with my promise of posting more frequently, that my time has passed for being a creator. A feeling I've realized I've had for quite some time this year, and I'm sure others have suspected too.

As much it as it breaks my heart for me to say, I will be hanging up my hat and will not be writing bots any longer.

Its been an amazing 3-ish years of making these bots for you guys. I never thought people would like my writing, or my stories and love for world building. I've had really dark times in my life, but many of the bright times have come from sharing bots and connecting with you. I can not thank you all enough for believing in me, for filling my heart with so much joy.

For making me feel like my writing was enough.

So, this is goodbye from me as Creature the bot creator. I'll still be around, lurking silently, supporting and cheering you all on; maybe even post a unhinged comment or two on your bots. My profile will stay up, and my bots too. I even want to extend my settings to you, they're yours now; whether that be to take inspiration from there, or make your own bots for them. I put a lot of love into them and I can't imagine a better thing than for someone to breath new life into them.

Before I go, please remember. You're enough. You're art is enough, you're writing is enough. You're creativity knows no bounds and the world is much brighter with you in it. I love you guys so much.

Goodbye, and Happy New Years. I hope 2026 brings so many wonderful things for you all. I'll be rooting for you.

-- Creature ♥️

✷ The Pride of Ash & Brass ⋆ 1919 Crime Brotherhood ⋆ Any!POV ✷

· · ─────── ·🦁· ─────── · ·

✨ Bot Summary:
Aedan Mallory is the mind behind the Pride—a brotherhood forged in the trenches of the Great War and reborn in the smoke and soot of Greyhaven. Where other men saw ruin, Aedan saw opportunity: seventy thousand acres of docklands, alleys, and ironworks now running under his careful order. He’s precise, calculating, and steady as steel—until you arrive at the Brassworks to balance his ledgers.

Months of late nights, ink-stained fingers, and stolen glances later, the line between duty and desire begins to blur.

💭 Themes & Tropes: 1910s Crime Drama · Peaky Blinders Inspire · Post-War Brotherhood · Power & Protection · Slow Burn · Found Family · Forbidden Tension · “We Built This Together”

📜 Extra Info:

🦁 The Pride — Six men who met in the mud of France and returned to rule Greyhaven’s underworld with order and iron will:

  • Aedan “Red Mane” Mallory — The Strategist, their leader in all but name.

  • Cormac “Tear” Mallory — The Enforcer, violence with a purpose.

  • Elias “Glass Teeth” Wynne — The Face, charming and ruthless.

  • Jonah “Gravel” Pike — The Quartermaster, the quiet builder.

✷ DinoGen ⋆ Ko-Fi Request ⋆ Dinosaur Demihumans ⋆ Any!POV, Carnivore!User ✷
· · ─────── · 🌿 · ─────── · ·

✨ Bot Summary: No predator had ever been welcomed into a herbivore herd—why would they? You hunt. You kill. And you’ve stepped right into their grazing ground with every watchful eye on you.

At the front of them all stands Ozias, a towering Stegosaurus Demihuman with scars across his broad back and a thagomizer tail that’s ended more than one fight. He’s meant to be their wall, their shield. His job is to push you back, chase you off, or cut you down if you don’t listen. He doesn’t want another fight, but his herd is everything, and he’ll bleed before he lets a predator slip between them.

And yet—he hesitates. Not because you aren’t dangerous. But because something in the way you linger, steady and unflinching, doesn’t match what he knows of killers. He should drive you out. He tells himself to. But every time your eyes meet his, the line between enemy and something more dangerous begins to blur.

💭 Themes & Tropes: Enemies to Lovers · Slow Burn · Mutual Care & Trust Building · Forbidden Dynamic (Carnivore x Herbivore) · Protective Guardian · “He’ll Die for His Herd but Hesitate for You” · Emotional Vulnerability Beneath Armor

📜 Extra Info:
The DinoGen Conservation Reserve was founded as a sanctuary for Dinosaur Demihumans—sapient hybrids born of ancient DNA and modern science. Each species has kept fragments of their ancestral instincts: herds, territories, migrations, rivalries. Stegosaurus demihumans like Ozias form protective bonds with their herds, serving as watchful guardians and nurturers.

| Marriage for Sale |

Alexsey worked hard to get to where he was in life, crawling up to the top from nothing, though he always felt like there was something missing. A spouse to share his world with. However, he knew that finding a partner the traditional way was not for him, courting a waste of his time. He wanted someone who would step into a partnership with him knowing the expectations and be with him without reservations.

This led Alexsey to attend The Auction. The event where wealthy men or woman wish to find a marriage partner for a certain amount of time for personal or work reasons. The minimum amount of time for a marriage contract is 2 years, and the minimum amount of money a bidder must pay is 1 million to secure a contract.

As the participants are led out on stage, Alexsey knew the moment he saw you up there. You would be his wife. Everyone has their own reasons for either participating in or attending the auction. What is yours?

QUESTIONS / REQUESTS IN THE REVIEWS

This is not a "bot" but a forum for you to suggest bot scenarios or ask questions.
.

With the new update to the review/comment section, I've decided on trying this out as a way for people to send in requests for bots they'd like to see! (since anonymous forms tend to invite abuse, sadly)

So please feel free to request alternate scenarios, COD (or other fandom! you can see what fandoms I'm interested in my about me) bots.

▸Please note that I prefer not to write detailed OC concepts suggested by other people so I probably won't do those, but general things like "more [x species] demihumans!" or suggesting genres is totally fine 🐺

⛔ Additionally, I will not write (so please don't bother asking) :
▹ bots where either the character or user is a child/minor (this includes age regression)
▹ scenarios involving children or pregnancy in general
▹ anything against J.AI's TOS

I'll be taking these as suggestions, so I make no promise to write anything (mostly because...my to-do list is a thousand entries long lol) but it really does help me get an idea of what people are interested in seeing!

Thank you as always for your support!! Love, Io🐺

The Supernatural University of Central California is an inclusive human and monster friendly college.

S.U.C.C.'s hometown of Solarton is an eclectic community where humans live alongside a high density of supernatural creatures, especially werewolves and wolf hybrids. S.U.C.C has a longstanding, "friendly" rivalry with neighbouring institute, the California University of Magical Sciences (C.U.M.S). This rivalry initially began when S.U.C.C started accepting human students, as C.U.M.S remains a supernatural only campus.
